text:
Predicates:
ArtificiallySelected(x) ::: x is artificially selected.
HeckCattle(x) ::: x is Heck cattle.
BreedBack(x, y) ::: x is bred-back to resemble y.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Extinct(y) ::: y is extinct.
Animals(x) ::: x is animals.
Aurochs(x) ::: x is aurochs.
Premises:
BreedingBack(x) ::: breeding back is a form of artificial selection.
HeckCattle(x) ∧ BreedBack(x, Aurochs) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back to resemble the aurochs.
HeckCattle(x) ∧ Animals(x) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Aurochs(x) ∧ Animals(x) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x (Animals(x) ∧ Resemble(x, y) ∧ Extinct(y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.
Conclusion:
∃x (HeckCattle(x) ∧ ArtificiallySelected(x)) ::: Some Heck cattle are artificially selected.
